classes.name: results
classes.reason: write_staged calls os.fsync(fd) before close, so the writing rank stalls for durability while other ranks proceed independently through their own generation/task loop, and this happens for each of GENERATIONS*TASKS_PER_RANK=200 result writes per rank.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: write_buffered only performs os.write and os.close with no fsync, so the write is left in the page cache and the rank moves on without waiting for storage completion, repeated once per generation/task (200 times per rank) with no synchronization forcing other ranks to wait.
